blurb: Ed Moger Racing Stable trains Thoroughbred race horses and manages a horse farm used for lay-up and breeding. Ed Moger is a multiple graded stakes winning trainer with extensive experience and a strong reputation. The stable operates primarily in Kentucky and races at several major tracks.
